items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: he never worked for Pete Lala

ctx.x: Um, and he says he worked for Pete Lala at one point, didn't he? Well, that's not true.

He didn't know that it wasn't true, but he never worked for Pete Lala. Oh, okay. See, when I talked with Louie about it, which was right after the big article about him came out in Life magazine. Right. And they had sent me the article first to check out, you know, the, the facts. Yeah. The whole article, as you know, was merely taping Louie.
